## Check step

Batch "B5 check" (M-CHECK, plan §9.3), 2026-09-30 22:42–23:15 UTC, after the 22:39 container restart, branch `design/three-films`. **Credits spent: 0.** No Higgsfield call was made and nothing was regenerated. Nothing was written to `public/`, `lib/`, `LOG.md` or the ledgers, and nothing was committed. A partial pre-restart attempt left only scratch frames; everything below was redone from the masters. Deliverables are in `docs/build/media-staged/p3/accepted/`: `<stem>-loop.mp4`, `.webm`, `-poster.webp` and `<stem>-loop.json` (full before/after checks, prompt, patch recipe, flags, manifest proposal). Working files are in the session scratchpad `p3/m56/`.

**Method.**
- `check` ran on each master and on both encodes with `--plate` and static/light zones from the map and `lib/media.ts`.
- The L2 sweep looked at master frames 0/25/50/75/100% (full frame + 200% crops of the stopwatch, pen, case, ship, moon and fog) and at encode frames 0/25/50/75/100% (200% stopwatch, 300% ship, 100% moon/fog). Motion was measured as Farneback flow vs frame 0 in 1920-px units. Flicker was checked per 16×16 block.
- Slit-scans (±36 frames) and wrap strips were read on both codecs. Banding was checked at 4–6× high-pass gain. Nobody watched the joins in real time (Aryan, per spec §6.4). The slit-scans show no seam.
- SSIM is yuv at 960×540, and "pct" is the share of natural steps ≤ the join. All three are `--method=residual --k=12`, with one keyframe per loop and tail boost 2. **Tiers per the M-CHECK brief:** L19/L20 are S (1920×1080) and L18 is I (1280×720). The map had listed all three as I.

**L18 iconic-pen-alt (work head, I).**
- **Raw master.** The stopwatch dial reads 1.99/255 and the stopwatch zone 2.00, against a limit of 1. x8 diff crops at frames 36/72/108/144 show edge boil on the bezel, bow and ticks only. The hand keeps its angle, so this is Kling texture re-render, not a sweep.
- **0-credit fix (the L17 precedent).** Frame 0 is composited over a feathered stopwatch mask: body ellipse (1709,763, 130×94), bow/crown ellipse (1804,672, 54×36) and a stem rect, dilated 6 px with σ 4. The result is `media-src/p3/masters/L18-iconic-pen-alt-99005831-watchhold.mkv` (FFV1, gitignored). On the patched master the dial reads 0.05.
- **Hold boundary.** Mean \|ΔY\| in 4–16 px bands inside / outside the mask is 0.25 / 1.57 on the MP4 and 0.05 / 1.33 on the WebM. The outside value is desk-reflection shimmer. No edge is visible at 200%.
- **L2.** The dial shows ticks only (no numerals) and the hand does not move. The pen engraving stays abstract. The chalkboard keeps the plate's smudges with no letters. No figures and no new objects.
- **Near-still, as L17.** Flow is ≤ 1.24 px anywhere, the light zones move 0.4–1.2 % with 0 reversals/s, and no dust motes are visible.

**L19 voyage-b (journey fog beat, S).**
- **Motion.** The sea visibly rolls and re-forms (100% crops at frames 0/12/24/48/72/108; flow p99 58 px). Fog drifts only low on the horizon (p99.9 9.4 px). The upper fog and the moon hold (0.28 / 0.50 px), so the "fog drifts right to left" clause is weak.
- **Why `pass.light` reads false.** The informative sea zone was passed as `--light`: its mean luma of 16.4–19.2 dims once over the loop, a ptp of 15.9 % of a near-black mean (2.8/255). That is glint density, not a glow. Whole-frame luma moves 2.2 %, there are 0 flashes, and the per-block flicker max is 0.5 reversals/s.
- **L2.** No ship, figures or text appear in the fog or on the sea.
- **Banding.** None at 6× gain on the fog or the moon halo at WebM CRF 26.
- **Size.** MP4 1.28 MB (S sea target ≤ 2.5 MB).

**L20 voyage-d (journey end, S).**
- **The ship stays on the horizon.**
  - The silhouette centroid moves ≤ 0.8 px over all 145 master frames, and a 56-px patch shifts ≤ 0.08 px.
  - The horizon row sits at y 453.43–453.51 px (0.4199; the marks say 0.419).
  - The ship zone's 2.05–2.28/255 is the requested "rocks a hair" re-render plus the glinting water under the hull, so it is recorded, not failed.
- **L2 at 300%.** A three-masted silhouette with lit ports only: no crew, flag symbol or lettering, and the same shape as the plate on every sampled frame.
- **Motion.** The glowing wake's glints shimmer (16×9 tile max 14/255, block flicker ≤ 0.5 reversals/s). Clouds, first light and the ship are near-still.
